patterns.name: Overscroll footer reveal
patterns.description: At the scroll limit, further wheel deltas become pressure that lifts the whole page off a fixed footer, then drops it back on a different curve.

patterns.name: Push-and-cover page transition
patterns.description: The outgoing page is pushed upward while a panel in the destination's own colour rises over it; the swap happens under cover and the new page arrives from the same offset.

patterns.name: Section progress navigation
patterns.description: A side nav generated from the page's own sections, each item carrying a progress line scrubbed across that section's range, anchored to the viewport centre.

patterns.name: Reversible line mask reveal
patterns.description: Per-line clip-path masks that open at the bottom for descenders, with an authored exit at 0.6x duration, different easing and reversed stagger.

patterns.name: Drag-spring 3D object
patterns.description: Scroll scrubs a base rotation while dragging adds a clamped tilt integrated by a real spring; orthographic frustum rebuilt from container aspect.

patterns.name: Three-state spring cursor
patterns.description: Three cursor heads sharing one lerped position, transformed from the viewport centre and crossfaded by delegated hover state.

patterns.name: Gated preloader
patterns.description: Three independent readiness gates converge on one exit; the looping mark always finishes its current cycle, and a session flag picks full or short intro.
